Closure gives sum_{j != i} e_i·e_j=-1, G=-n/2; pair-overlap sums H=n/2-T and K=n(n-4)/8+T/2, T=(n²+J-2n)/4 with J=|sum exp(2i theta)|². Hypergeometric q2,q3,q4 yield Var=A_nk+B_nk J, positive B, and mean k(n-k)/(n-1). 0<=J<=n²; zero iff tight frame and max iff antipodal collinear balanced; explicit continuously varying antipodal strictly convex walk realizes every interior value. Eigenvalues (n ± sqrt J)/2 recovered from one variance. Independently enumerated rational unit-antipodal edge sets n=4,6,8,10 for all k and confirmed exact moments.
